# Browser libraries

Pinned browser distributions from the publishers' npm packages; no build step or CDN requests.

- [Marked](https://marked.js.org/) 18.1.1: Markdown parser, MIT license.
- [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) 3.4.17: HTML sanitizer, distributed under the included MPL-2.0/Apache-2.0 license.

[manifest.json](manifest.json) records exact source archives and file hashes. Package archives were checked against the npm registry's SHA-512 integrity values before extracting these distributions. Preserve the license files when updating them.
